thread:
Alex S: kicking off — need billing/org provision for Acme trial. Goal: Hosted API keys for devs + demo of a small dedicated pool next Wed. Prefer spend cap $5k for the two-week POC. Who can create the org and set credits?
Priya (SE): I can own the provisioning. Quick Q: do you want ephemeral dev keys only or a long-lived project key for the POC? For Dedicated demo we usually need a signed order form.
Marco (Acme IT): hi — I'm Marco (IT). Emma is finance (cc). Ephemeral keys are fine for devs; we also want admin key to hook CI. Demo Wed works.
Emma (Acme Finance): we can sign a short PO today. If that speeds things up, tell us amount & billing contact.
Priya (SE): Two paths: 1) Hosted POC: we can mint ephemeral dev keys + a single admin key. Default trial credits are $2k for 30 days. To increase to $5k for POC, RevOps approval or a PO required. 2) Dedicated trial: needs order form + legal or a demo seat on reserved capacity (limited availability).
Nina (RevOps): I can approve a one-time promo to reach $5k if legal has a countersigned PO or email approval from Emma with PO number. ETA 24–48h after we have PO + billing profile.
Alex S: what's needed from Acme to create the billing org right now?
Priya (SE): I need: customer billing email, billing contact name (Emma), billing address on PO, and preferred spend cap value. Also whether you want us to mint keys in the hosted org or prep for Private/VPC (different checklist).
Marco (Acme IT): sending Emma's contact now. We want hosted keys first, then evaluate Dedicated. Also question: can you integrate our KMS later if we move to private?
Priya (SE): Yes — Hosted: Redwood holds keys. Private/VPC: we can integrate customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) and do HSM-backed keys per SQA. That adds ~3–5 business days of ops work for onboarding.

onboarding-bot: created billing org org_acme_001 and service account sa_acme_poc.
onboarding-bot: minted admin key key_admin_7b2f (long-lived) and 3 ephemeral dev keys (devkey_01, devkey_02, devkey_03). Admin key permissions: billing, model-access, deploy.
Priya (SE): pasted the quick CLI for future reference: 
```
rctl billing create-org --name "Acme Corp" --owner marco@acme.com --po-number PO-12345
rctl keys mint --org org_acme_001 --type ephemeral --count 3
```
Priya (SE): Note: keep admin key in your vault. For release demos we recommend ephemeral keys + CI integration to limit blast radius.
Emma (Acme Finance): PO-12345 created and attached. What's the next step for Nina?
Nina (RevOps): I have the PO. I'll attach a one-time promo credit of $3k to top up to $5k total for the POC. Will confirm once done (aiming EOD).
Marco (Acme IT): timeline question — if we need to lift spend cap mid-POC, how fast?
Nina (RevOps): if it's just lifting a spend cap on hosted: 24–48h with internal approval. If change requires contract amendment (Dedicated/reserved), that takes longer.
Priya (SE): For Dedicated demo we also need expected RPS and target latency so infra can size a small pool. If we stick to hosted, I'll schedule the demo environment and share endpoints.
Alex S: can we get a short checklist we can send to Acme?
Priya (SE): checklist: 1) Acme sends PO (done). 2) RevOps applies promo credits (in progress). 3) I provision hosted keys & test routes (done). 4) Marco shares IP ranges if you want VPC peering later. 5) For Dedicated: sign order form + provide expected traffic profile + legal SOW.
Marco (Acme IT): sending IP ranges and a basic traffic estimate by EOD.
Priya (SE): I'll do the demo config after Nina confirms credits. If credits not approved, we can still do a limited hosted demo (smaller token allowances).
Alex S: perfect — thanks everyone :thumbsup: 
Priya (SE): looping eng-sec if Acme asks for security questionnaire specifics for Private: @eng-sec we'll need SOC2 report share, KMS integration guide, and network checklist for peering.
Priya (SE): final note — I'll drop the admin key rotation instructions and a short runbook in the POC folder once Nina confirms credits.
Alex S: great, closing loop after Nina confirms.
